# Anthony Today

> Anthony Kieffer is a certified Notion Consulting Partner and former EY cybersecurity consultant (CISSP, CISA, CISM, CRISC, AIGP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer), with 15+ years in technology risk and IT audit across Luxembourg, Switzerland and the USA. This site offers Notion workspace consulting, cybersecurity and GRC advisory, fractional CISO services, and a catalog of Notion templates, free and premium. The site is bilingual: English at https://www.anthonytoday.com/ and French at https://www.anthonytoday.com/fr/.

## Services

- [Notion Consulting](https://www.anthonytoday.com/notion/): workspace architecture, workflow automation, AI workflows, governance and security. Entry point: Notion Ops Audit at $197. Discovery Call $79. Audit and Design $1,500 to $6,000. Risk and Governance Build $5,000 to $20,000+.
- [Cybersecurity and GRC](https://www.anthonytoday.com/cyber/): risk management frameworks, compliance remediation, audit readiness.
- [GRC](https://www.anthonytoday.com/cyber-grc/): governance, risk and compliance programs.
- [Fractional CISO](https://www.anthonytoday.com/fractional-ciso/): part-time security leadership.
- [Investor-Ready Sprint](https://www.anthonytoday.com/investor-ready-sprint/): fixed-scope Notion build for real estate investment and property firms.

## Guides and reference content

- [Ultimate Notion Guide](https://www.anthonytoday.com/guide/): beginner-to-pro guide covering pages, blocks, databases, automations, formulas, sharing and pricing.
- [Top 10 Notion Questions](https://www.anthonytoday.com/notion/challenges/): the ten questions clients ask most, each with the answer and a template to start from. French version: https://www.anthonytoday.com/fr/notion/challenges/
- [Client use case](https://www.anthonytoday.com/use-case/): an engagement walkthrough, from audit to results.
